description: plan4res Dataset for the Senegal 2030 Power System: Deterministic and Stochastic Case Studies is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Sébastien Ahmany Dan-Baibe, Thomas Ouillon (Électricité de France (France)). This dataset contains the data and model configuration files used for the Senegal 2030 power system case study developed with the plan4res framework within the OpenMod4Africa project and Deliverable D5.2, Energy transition pathways in the WAPP region. The dataset is based on the Senegal 2030 energy system scenario developed with GENeSYS-MOD. Coverage: national (SN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
